与兴趣爱好一起成长(Growing up with hobbies): 一篇关于兴趣爱好的B1记叙文:马克斯的经历、感受与成长。

Max wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Max ordered salad and coffee at the story-writing desk last night. The dance studio looked quieter than usual that evening. Best of all, they go fishing at the lake at dawn.

Max has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. People around Max often share different ideas about the dance studio. Little by little, things began to change. For example, the actor forgot one line but smiled.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Max bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. On Friday evenings, Max reviews the notes from class. He whistled a happy tune.

At first, Max found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Best of all, camping by the river is cheap and fun.
Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Max more than any book could.
